top_signals.title: Policy paper: HM Treasury Market Engagement Group summary minutes – November 2026
top_signals.summary: A senior level forum for financial market participants to share their views on UK-related developments in financial markets, including gilts and sterling, and broader market themes with the Chancellor of the Exchequer.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: Ukraine exposes ransomware network extorting US oil, healthcare firms
top_signals.summary: Ukrainian authorities arrested four suspected members of an international ransomware network accused of extorting more than $40 million from companies around the world.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Fed Tells Regional Staff to Expect Lower Pay Hikes in 2027
top_signals.summary: The Federal Reserve has warned employees at its regional outposts to expect lower pay increases next year, according to a memo viewed by Bloomberg News.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Minutes of the Market Participants Group meeting – 18 November 2026
top_signals.summary: The Market Participants Group (MPG) is a senior-level forum for financial market participants to share their views on relevant themes and narratives in financial markets with members of the Bank of England’s Monetary Policy Committee.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: Federal Reserve announces revised tentative schedule of Federal Open Market Committee meetings in 2027
top_signals.summary: Federal Reserve announces revised tentative schedule of Federal Open Market Committee meetings in 2027
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: Gold's bad year is getting worse. Why its price keeps falling
top_signals.summary: Gold has fallen sharply from its January record as higher interest rates and a stronger dollar change the investment case for the precious metal.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.

top_signals.title: Jefferson, New Technology, Old Questions: Productivity Puzzles  and the Macroeconomy
top_signals.summary: Speech At the University of California, San Diego Economic Roundtable, San Diego, California

top_signals.title: Ethereum’s new DeFi security tool raises questions over censorship
top_signals.summary: Phylax’s system lets decentralized protocols block potentially harmful transactions, but raises questions about potential censorship and Ethereum’s concentrated builder market.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Digital asset volatility and institutional crypto positioning changes.

top_signals.title: Brazil’s central bank steps in to stem real’s slide since Lula’s re-election
top_signals.summary: Currency has slipped from R$5 to R$5.90 to the dollar following leftwinger’s victory last month

top_signals.title: Climate talks drop fossil fuel phaseout and pivot to carbon capture
top_signals.summary: Final COP31 sessions focusing on energy security rather than climate change
